title: Basis transform ValueTracker
prerequisite: Learner can read basis vectors e1 and e2 as arrows on a grid.
success_check: Learner predicts where e1 and e2 land after a 90-degree rotation and that det stays 1, then compares.

scenes.title: Basis transform ValueTracker
scenes.concept_target: Basis vectors e1 and e2 rotate together while det stays 1 as tracker alpha sweeps.

narration_cues.text: Here are basis vectors e1 and e2. The tracker alpha is at zero, and det equals one.
narration_cues.change: Basis shown at identity; det readout reads 1 with tracker at zero.

narration_cues.text: As the tracker alpha sweeps to ninety degrees, e1 and e2 rotate together and det stays one.
narration_cues.change: Basis rotated together by the tracker; det readout stays 1.
